# Contract: code-loop

Foundation skill from [simcraft](https://github.com/dotslashsimran/simcraft) at `58224d1` (MIT, Simran Sachdeva), modified by SumitCraft. Category: video. Kind: scripted.

## Purpose
Deterministic three.js or GLSL scenes rendered to seamless looping video and checked for seams, freezes and flicker.

## Use it for
- "render this shader as a perfect loop"
- "seamless generative loop video"

## Not for
- an illustrated city scene with dolly zooms (perspective-illusion)
- a screen recording (scripted-screencast)

## Accepted inputs
A page following the loop contract (window.LOOP, READY, render, renderMany, setJitter).

## Deliverables
stills, preview.mp4, final.mp4 (+GIF), <out>.render.json manifest, check_loop report and blink heatmap.

## Prerequisites
Required:
- Node.js 18.19+
- Playwright npm package (npm install)
- Playwright Chromium binary (npx playwright install chromium, ~150-200 MB)
- ffmpeg (on PATH or FFMPEG)

Optional:
- three@0.170.0 in the work folder
- Python 3.9+
- NumPy

Check them with `node tools/doctor.mjs` (Windows: `tools\doctor.ps1`).

## Local and network behaviour
npm install in the work folder if three.js is used; rendering is local.

## Cost-sensitive operations
Finals with 8-32 samples per frame are slow on software WebGL; previews first.

## Workflow
1. Everything is a pure function of the phase
2. Every periodic motion has a whole number of cycles per loop:
3. Loop noise by walking a circle through it
4. Easing must end where it starts
5. Do not wrap ms with % in the page
6. The loop length must be a whole number of frames
7. Stills
8. Preview
9. Final
10. Check

Full steps: [SKILL.md](SKILL.md).

## Human decisions
- Approve stills, then the preview
- Declare deliberate holds

## Quality checks
- Exact seam frame comparison
- check_loop.py seam, freeze (minus declared holds), blink
- a person watches it loop

## Common failures
- Non-integer cycles per loop slip at the seam
- Screen-anchored grain blinks
- WebGL unavailable: renderer relaunches with the default backend, then stops with a clear error

## Limitations
- Freeze and blink numbers are diagnostics, not taste
- GPU acceleration is only claimed when the WebGL renderer says so

## Reproducible example
templates/shader_starter.html at preview settings, plus a planted bad loop (evidence/code-loop).

## Validation status
**functionally verified** (2026-11-13, Linux 6.18.44-fc-v445 (x86_64), Python 3.13.18). exact seam, real loop: frame at LOOP vs frame 0: mean 0.001, max 1 (0-255), 0 pixels differ by more than 2 (pass); planted 1.37-cycle loop: frame at LOOP vs frame 0: mean 18.252, max 219 (0-255), 31105 pixels differ by more than 2 (caught); declared-hold clip: 'frozen spans' failure without --holds, reported as intended with --holds. Overall verdicts: preview FAIL: seam pop: part of the picture jumps by 2.8 levels at the wrap; 1 pops inside the loop; small final (320x180, 30 fps, 4-8 samples): PASS

Visual or audible review: visually reviewed (agent): preview frame at 2 s of the shader starter; the loop itself was checked numerically, not watched on repeat by a person. Native Windows: not run. Details and gaps: [docs/VALIDATION_MATRIX.md](../../docs/VALIDATION_MATRIX.md).
